WoW: Forever

Rogue

Rogue is a leather-wearing melee class with no self-heal that opens fights from stealth. Forever made Lockpicking and Poisons secondary skills, added ShankShankSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 2CastInstantCost5 EnergyRangeMeleeCooldown10 sec cooldownInstantly strike with your off-hand weapon, dealing 50% weapon damage and generating 15 Energy. Shank cannot Miss. at 24, and using SapSapLevel 10 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCost65 EnergyRangeMeleeDuration25 secIncapacitates the target for up to 25 sec. Only works on Humanoids that are not in combat. Any damage taken will break the effect. Only 1 target may be sapped at a time. Does not break Stealth. no longer breaks StealthStealthLevel 1 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCooldown10 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledAllows the rogue to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 50%. Lasts until cancelled..

Back to top

Written for the live game, levels 1 to 60. Blizzard's development notes of November 2 are the authority on talents, then its Rogue class deep dive of October 7: where a guide site or a tooltip still carries an older talent name or effect, Blizzard's text wins. Training levels and percentages are read from the client, build 1.60.1.70938, which Blizzard mostly does not publish. Blizzard has not tuned Rogue since launch on November 4; its only Rogue hotfixes, on November 6, corrected two tooltips. Builds on the spec pages are Icy Veins', Wowhead's and WoWSims', named and dated. No raid opens before December 9, so there are no raid logs, and nothing here about level 60 damage is measured. Talent levels assume no Legacy TalentedTalentedTalentCastInstantYou gain talent points every level starting at level 5 instead of starting at level 10, but you still may not have more than 51 total talent points. perk, which starts your points up to five levels earlier. If a tooltip on this page differs from the text, go by the text.

All three are melee damage, so pick on how you want to play rather than on role. Blizzard's own summary: Assassination "specializes in daggers and buffing themselves with Finishing moves", Combat is direct damage with a little cleave, and Subtlety is "combat tricks and Bleeds". Dual specialisation is sold by the class trainer at level 40 for 50 gold, per Wowhead, so the choice is not permanent.

Is Rogue for you?

Play Rogue if you like deciding when a fight starts, and you are willing to level a class wearing leather with no self-heal.

Strengths

  • You choose when every fight starts: StealthStealthLevel 1 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCooldown10 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledAllows the rogue to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 50%. Lasts until cancelled. from level 1, opening with AmbushAmbushLevel 18 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 6CastInstantCost60 EnergyRangeMeleeAmbush the target, causing 250% weapon damage plus 70 to the target. Must be stealthed and behind the target. Requires a dagger in the main hand. Awards 1 combo point. from 18
  • StealthStealthLevel 1 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCooldown10 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledAllows the rogue to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 50%. Lasts until cancelled. and SprintSprintLevel 10 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCooldown300 sec cooldownDuration15 secIncreases the rogue's movement speed by 50% for 15 sec. Does not break stealth. let you walk past a fight instead of winning it
  • Six ways to stop an enemy acting: GougeGougeLevel 6 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost45 EnergyRangeMeleeCooldown10 sec cooldownDuration4 secCauses 10 damage, stops your attack, and incapacitates the target for 4 sec. New to this class?

Is the rotation simple? While levelling, yes: build combo points, spend them, press ShankShankSpell · Physical · Rank 1 of 2CastInstantCost5 EnergyRangeMeleeCooldown10 sec cooldownInstantly strike with your off-hand weapon, dealing 50% weapon damage and generating 15 Energy. Shank cannot Miss. every 10 seconds from 24.

Is it forgiving? No: no self-heal, and leather armour.

What carries you while levelling? StealthStealthLevel 1 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCooldown10 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledAllows the rogue to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 50%. Lasts until cancelled. from level 1, so you choose every fight.

Does it need a group? No. StealthStealthLevel 1 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCooldown10 sec cooldownDurationUntil cancelledAllows the rogue to sneak around, but reduces your speed by 50%. Lasts until cancelled. lets you walk past the fights you would lose.

Which race

Read this section in proportion. Race is the smallest of the choices on this page, well behind spec, gear and knowing your rotation, and no race is a wrong answer for levelling (ours, not a source's). Racials decide things in PvP, specifically the ones that break crowd control. Will of the ForsakenWill of the ForsakenTalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration0.1 secInstantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects. (Undead) stops fear, sleep and charm; Escape ArtistEscape ArtistTalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration3 secInstantly escape the effects of any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to those effects for 3 sec. (Gnome) breaks roots and snares; StoneformStoneformTalentCastInstantCooldown180 sec cooldownDuration8 secInstantly removes and grants immunity to all Bleed, Poison, and Disease effects, and reduces all Physical damage taken by 10% for 8 sec. (Dwarf) clears bleeds, poisons and disease; Will to SurviveWill to SurviveTalentCastInstantCooldown180 sec cooldownInstantly removes all Stun effects. (Human) removes stuns. A free trinket slot is worth more than any damage racial below.

Alliance: Human for long fights, on RuthlessRuthlessTalentCastInstantIncreases your critical strike chance with all spells and attacks by 1%. at +1% crit with all spells and attacks. Gnome is the better levelling pick, for Eureka!Eureka!TalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration8 secYour non-periodic damaging abilities have their Energy cost reduced by 10% and deal 10% more damage for 8 sec. and Escape ArtistEscape ArtistTalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration3 secInstantly escape the effects of any movement impairing effect and gain immunity to those effects for 3 sec.. Both calls are (ours, not a source's).

Horde: no clear winner (ours, not a source's). Orc has Blood FuryBlood FuryTalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration15 secIncreases Attack Power and Spell Power by 10% for 15 sec., 10% Attack Power for 15 seconds on a 2-minute cooldown, and HardinessHardinessTalentCastInstantDuration of Stun effects on you reduced by 20%., which makes stuns 20% shorter. Troll has BerserkingBerserkingTalentCastInstantCooldown180 sec cooldownDuration15 sec, 10% attack speed for 15 seconds. Undead has Will of the ForsakenWill of the ForsakenTalentCastInstantCooldown120 sec cooldownDuration0.1 secInstantly removes all Charm, Fear and Sleep effects. and Touch of the GraveTouch of the GraveTalentCastInstantYour spells and attacks have a 20% chance to drain Health from the target, up to 5% of your maximum Health., a 20% chance for a Rogue's attacks to drain Health, with a 15-second internal cooldown.

Weapon choice is looser in Forever. No racial depends on a weapon, Rogues can use one-handed axes, and Hack and SlashHack and SlashTalent · Rank 5 of 5CastInstantGives your melee weapon attacks a benefit depending on the weapon. Axe/Sword: Your successful melee attacks have a 5% chance to trigger an extra attack on the target. Dagger/Fist: Increases your critical strike chance by 5%. Mace: Your attacks ignore 15% of your target's armor. gives axes the same bonus as swords. Your weapon no longer picks your spec for you.

Quality of life

  • The level-20 poison quest is the one thing you must not skip (ours, not a source's). Icy Veins says to have Pick PocketPick PocketLevel 4 · Spell · PhysicalCastInstantRangeMeleePick the target's pocket. and Pick LockPick LockSpell · PhysicalCast5 sec castRangeMeleeAllows opening of locked chests and doors. trained and Lockpicking at 75 before you start it. In Forever a poison and a sharpening stone or weightstone go on the same weapon at once, where Classic made you choose. Every poison also carries more charges than it did.
  • Lockpicking: two readings. The client lists Pick LockPick LockSpell · PhysicalCast5 sec castRangeMeleeAllows opening of locked chests and doors. among the spells a Rogue starts with at level 1. Icy Veins' milestone table puts a Lockpicking class quest at 15, and Gaunerh, playing at launch, trains the skill at 16 and levels it on the practice chests of the Ratchet quest. If your spellbook has no Pick LockPick LockSpell · PhysicalCast5 sec castRangeMeleeAllows opening of locked chests and doors. at level 1, that is where it comes from.

At level 60

What you bring to a group is damage on one target and control. Icy Veins and Wowhead say the same thing from two directions: no party buff, no area damage, and a long list of stuns, interrupts and incapacitates. Icy Veins' advice for dungeons is to SapSapLevel 10 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 3CastInstantCost65 EnergyRangeMeleeDuration25 secIncapacitates the target for up to 25 sec. Only works on Humanoids that are not in combat. Any damage taken will break the effect. Only 1 target may be sapped at a time. Does not break Stealth. before the pull, KickKickLevel 12 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 4CastInstantCost25 EnergyRangeMeleeCooldown10 sec cooldownDuration5 secA quick kick that injures a single foe for 15 damage. It also interrupts spellcasting and prevents any spell in that school from being cast for 5 sec. and GougeGougeLevel 6 · Spell · Physical · Rank 1 of 5CastInstantCost45 EnergyRangeMeleeCooldown10 sec cooldownDuration4 secCauses 10 damage, stops your attack, and incapacitates the target for 4 sec. The target must be facing you. Any damage taken will break the effect. Awards 1 combo point. casters, and kill the most dangerous target while others clean up the rest. Blizzard states the class has "the highest potential single-target melee damage in the game."

Builds, rotations and stat lists for 60 are on the spec pages, from Icy Veins, Wowhead and WoWSims. None of them rests on a raid log yet: Barrow Deeps, Hyjal Summit and Onyxia's Lair open on December 9. Both sites mark their stat pages as early, and Icy Veins' best-in-slot pages were still empty on November 9 with the note "It's too early to tell."
